scope: producer package integrity and claim-boundary review of 1550 unpublished English candidates; not independent W9 QA or publication approval
allowed_reader_frame: cautious interpretation and low-risk action experiments
forbidden_claims: ability, fixed identity, or destiny claims
precise career match, job fit, hiring, admissions, income, or success prediction
private attempts, scores, vectors, percentiles, selectors, reports, tokens, orders, or payment data

findings.finding: All 1550 candidates remain unpublished, runtime-disabled, and pending W9 independent review.
